_about: Use-case-type facet — WHAT the AI actually does. 22 entries: 10 priority, 11 standard, 1 record_only. content-generation is standard, not priority: it is absent from the approved priority list, and following that list is the point. customer-interaction (priority, strictly external) and conversational-assistant (standard, includes internal copilots) are deliberately separate — decision V4.

entries.definition: The AI finds and returns existing information in response to a need: enterprise search, retrieval over documents, question answering grounded in a corpus.
exclusions: writing new content (that is content-generation)
owning the knowledge programme (that is the knowledge-management FUNCTION)

entries.definition: The AI ingests documents and turns them into structured, usable output: extraction, parsing, form and invoice processing, contract intake, OCR pipelines.
exclusions: condensing text for a reader (that is summarization-extraction)
routing a document without reading it (that is classification-routing)

entries.definition: The AI analyses data and produces analytical output: querying, metric exploration, report and dashboard generation, natural-language analytics.
exclusions: recommending an action to a human (that is decision-support)
predicting a future value (that is forecasting-prediction)
the data team itself (that is the data-analytics FUNCTION)
entries.disambiguation: Added by decision V1: decision-support is the downstream act; analysis and BI is the capability itself.

entries.definition: The AI executes or advances a defined multi-step business process end to end, replacing manual handoffs.
exclusions: an agent that plans its own steps and calls tools (that is agentic-orchestration)
classifying and forwarding only (that is classification-routing)
entries.disambiguation: The process is defined in advance; agentic-orchestration is when the system decides the steps.

entries.definition: The AI plans, calls tools, and coordinates multiple steps or sub-agents to reach a goal it was not given a fixed script for.
exclusions: a fixed scripted pipeline (that is workflow-automation)
a chat UI with no tool use (that is conversational-assistant)

entries.definition: The AI interacts directly with EXTERNAL customers, users, patients, citizens, members, guests or clients.
exclusions: internal employee copilots
a conversational interface used only by staff
a chat UI whose users are not identified as external
entries.disambiguation: Decision V4, priority, STRICTLY external. A chat interface alone is not evidence of customer interaction — a conversational interface proves nothing about who is on the other end. An external assistant may carry BOTH this and conversational-assistant, but only when each definition is independently evidenced.

entries.definition: The AI helps a human decide: options, trade-offs, recommendations and rationale presented for a person to act on.
exclusions: recommending items or content to a consumer (that is recommendation-personalization)
producing the analysis itself (that is data-analysis-bi)

entries.definition: The AI tailors items, content, offers or experiences to an individual user or segment.
exclusions: advising a professional on a business decision (that is decision-support)

entries.definition: The AI addresses a risk, fraud, financial-crime or regulatory-compliance PROBLEM: detection, screening, monitoring, controls testing.
exclusions: security threat operations (that is the information-security FUNCTION)
generic outlier detection with no risk framing (that is anomaly-detection)
entries.disambiguation: Added by decision V1; coexists deliberately with the legal-risk-compliance FUNCTION. This describes the problem being solved; that describes who does the work. A bank's fraud model built by its compliance team legitimately carries both, and that pair is NOT a duplicate or a conflict.

entries.definition: The AI teaches: tutoring, guided practice, explanation, assessment and feedback aimed at building a learner's capability.
exclusions: running an employee training programme (that is the training-enablement FUNCTION)
answering a question once with no teaching intent (that is search-retrieval)
entries.disambiguation: Added by decision V1: no value described AI that teaches. Named a near-miss pair with training-enablement in the ambiguity tests.

entries.definition: A conversational interface is the MODE of interaction — chat, voice or messaging — explicitly including internal employee copilots.
exclusions: a claim about WHO is on the other end — that is customer-interaction and needs its own evidence
entries.disambiguation: Demoted to standard by decision V4 precisely so it can never satisfy the Customer Interaction coverage target on its own. An internal employee assistant receives this value only.

entries.definition: The AI produces new content: copy, imagery, video, designs, drafts and creative variants.
exclusions: condensing existing text (that is summarization-extraction)
writing code (that is code-generation)
entries.disambiguation: Standard, not priority: it is absent from the approved priority list, and following that list is the point.

entries.definition: The AI condenses existing material or pulls specified elements out of it: summaries, key points, entity and field extraction from free text.
exclusions: a document-ingestion pipeline producing structured records (that is document-processing)
writing new material (that is content-generation)

entries.definition: The AI assigns items to categories or destinations: tagging, triage, prioritisation, queue and skill-based routing.
exclusions: detecting the unusual rather than assigning a known label (that is anomaly-detection)

entries.definition: The AI predicts a future value or event: demand, churn, failure, load, revenue.
exclusions: explaining what already happened (that is data-analysis-bi)
flagging present-tense outliers (that is anomaly-detection)

entries.definition: The AI flags departures from expected patterns: outliers, drift, faults and unusual behaviour, without a risk or fraud framing.
exclusions: fraud, financial-crime or regulatory framing (that is risk-fraud-compliance)

entries.definition: The AI writes, completes, reviews, tests or migrates software code.
exclusions: the engineering team itself (that is the software-engineering FUNCTION)

entries.definition: The AI translates between languages or adapts content for a locale.
exclusions: speech transcription without translation (that is speech-audio)

entries.definition: The AI processes or produces speech and audio: transcription, voice synthesis, call analytics, audio understanding.
exclusions: a voice channel that is only the interface (that is conversational-assistant)

entries.definition: The AI interprets images or video: visual inspection, defect detection, recognition, monitoring of physical scenes.
exclusions: reading text from scanned documents (that is document-processing)

entries.definition: The AI simulates, models or generates designs and candidate structures: generative design, molecular and materials discovery, digital twins, scenario simulation.
exclusions: forecasting a single business metric (that is forecasting-prediction)

entries.definition: The source describes what the AI does but supports no vocabulary value — the use-case type cannot be placed from the evidence available.
exclusions: an axis that does not apply at all (record not_applicable in unresolved[])
entries.disambiguation: The single sentinel shared by all three axes, and the only slug exempt from cross-axis disjointness.
